actions.reason: K6_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (PBRM1 near-universal mutation surviving global adjustment, with a proliferation-up/oxidative-metabolism-down RNA program), but independent membership is not positively supported. Set-scope geometry shows near-zero silhouettes in all four modalities with within- and between-set distances nearly identical, i.e., essentially no distinction of this membership from the rest of the partition. The set-scope confounder report shows no factor surviving multiplicity correction, so no candidate-specific technical alternative is established, but absence of a measured confounder does not positively establish an independent boundary. With membership representation unsupported and no warranted structural revision, retention as an independent unit is not justified.

K6_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (VHL-depleted/PBRM1-depleted driver profile with an immune-down/oxidative-metabolism-up RNA program), but independent membership is not positively supported. Set-scope geometry shows only modest positive silhouettes (largest WXS 0.184, RNA 0.025) with within-set distances only slightly below between-set distances, i.e., weak distinction of this membership from the rest of the partition. The set-scope confounder report shows no factor surviving multiplicity correction, so no candidate-specific technical alternative is established, but absence of a measured confounder does not positively establish an independent boundary. With membership representation only weakly supported and no warranted structural revision, retention as an independent unit is not justified.
